name: How can I update my kitchen lighting without a full remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I update my kitchen lighting without a full remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can update kitchen lighting without a full remodel by focusing on easily replaceable fixtures and adding new surface-mounted options. Swapping out old fluorescent lights for modern LED flush mounts or track lighting can dramatically improve ambiance. Adding plug-in or battery-operated under-cabinet lighting provides task illumination without extensive wiring. Considering a lighting control system with dimmers can also enhance flexibility and mood without major construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Update kitchen lighting without a remodel by replacing old fixtures, adding surface-mounted lights, or incorporating plug-in under-cabinet options.
